title: Turkish-Style Sausage Skillet
description: A gluten-free breakfast skillet recipe featuring juicy Turkish sausages and menemen.

ingredients.name: Menemen
ingredients.notes: Menemen is a Turkish-style scrambled egg dish made with sautéed onions, tomatoes and spices

ingredients.name: Juicy Tomatoes
ingredients.notes: Chopped or crushed tomatoes work well

instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the Turkish sausages and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the sausages from the skillet and set aside.
Add the menemen to the skillet and stir to combine with the sausage drippings.
Add the chopped tomatoes, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the sausages to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the menemen is set.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
